headline: Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley Vie for Anthropic IPO Lead Role
summary: Wall Street investment banks Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are competing to secure the top underwriting role for Anthropic's upcoming public offering.
why: Initial public offerings of major artificial intelligence labs are highly lucrative milestones that generate substantial advisory fees and shape capital markets.

impacts.name: Goldman Sachs
impacts.why: Securing the lead underwriting role in a high-profile IPO generates substantial advisory fees and prestige.

impacts.name: Morgan Stanley
